question: The acquisition of a foreign medicine is regulated in:

options.opa: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2015, of July 24, Consolidated text of the Law on Guarantee and rational use of medicines and health products.
options.opb: Royal Decree 1015/2009, of June 19, which regulates the availability of medicines in special situations.
options.opc: Royal Decree 782/2013, of 11 October, on the distribution of medicines for human use.
options.opd: Royal Decree 824/2010, of June 25, which regulates pharmaceutical laboratories, manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients and foreign trade in medicines and medicines under investigation.
